title.suggested: Allen and Tom Kelly attend the Burke–Mitchell fight in Chicago

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Tom Kelly returned from Chicago, where he and Tom Allen had watched the Burke–Mitchell fight. Kelly said the draw was wrong and Mitchell should have won.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Wednesday, May 12, 1886', page 7, first column.

facts.fact: Allen went to Chicago with Tom Kelly to watch the Jack Burke–Charley Mitchell fight

notes: The current title and summary credit the opinions to Allen, but every quoted opinion is Tom Kelly's. The summary also wrongly calls it a bare-knuckle bout, when two-ounce gloves were used. The Mitchell–Dempsey match news doesn't involve Allen.
